objective: Reconcile the private EKS operating path and execute a bounded Hoodi UC-1 Nethermind/Prysm redeployment proof, while retaining fail-closed validator and Vault-secret boundaries.
classification_reason: queries a private production EKS control plane
may temporarily create an SSM tunnel host and scale cost-bearing node pools and StatefulSets
must preserve Vault, Secret, and validator-key boundaries

external_actions: read non-sensitive EKS, Argo CD, Hoodi node-pool, StatefulSet, and Secret metadata
publish the reviewed immutable private GitOps client chart and promote the Argo CD Application revision after explicit user approval
create and later remove the reviewed temporary private SSM operations host using an approved state-aligned Terraform input set or an explicitly approved SSM-only recovery apply
correct the temporary SSM host's least-privilege HTTPS rule to reference the EKS-managed private API security group, then verify private EKS access
if and only if all documented prerequisites are observed, temporarily start and subsequently stop the approved Hoodi UC-1 client session
prohibited_actions: read, create, modify, decode, or print Secret data
initialize, unseal, reconfigure, or read data from Vault
deploy validator keys, withdrawal credentials, or a remote signer
change public endpoint, cluster access, or network policy boundaries

constraints: Use private EKS access only and retain TLS hostname verification.
Never record endpoint URLs, kubeconfig content, tokens, certificates, Secret values, keys, or raw logs in evidence.
Do not bypass absent Engine-JWT custody, a disabled client chart, or an unhealthy private Argo Application.

UC-2 through UC-5 remain contract and isolation verification only until separately approved validator-key, withdrawal-credential, remote-signer, slashing-history, backup, and recovery custody are available.
Return consensus and execution pools and client StatefulSets to the recorded cost-suspended state after a successful proof.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decision, live-operation integration, and sign-off

validation: state-aligned Terraform plan or explicitly approved SSM-only recovery plan
